## Summary

A concise description of the feature or capability you'd like to see.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve, or what learning/portfolio goal does it support?

## Proposed area

- [ ] New lab under `labs/`
- [ ] New tool under `tools/security` or `tools/sysadmin`
- [ ] CI/CD or contributor workflow improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Proposed approach

Describe how you'd implement this, if you have ideas. Not required.

## Impact on existing architecture

- [ ] This is additive and does not change existing lab topology, networking, or VM definitions.
- [ ] This would require changes to existing infrastructure (describe below).

## Additional context

Add any other context, references, or mockups here.
